correctness.rationale: For every 0<=a,b<1, all 16 flip rates are positive, so the limiting tilted eigenvalue and its first two derivatives exist. Four exact generator identities close the U,V,W,P moments. The explicit h=(U+bV-aW)/8-E[(U+bV-aW)/8] obeys Lh=j-f, providing the centered Poisson solution for the second heat cumulant. Direct symbolic substitution proves the polynomial coefficient and the fixed-mean noise identity, including normalization by 4J and the boundary-crossing condition. The standalone proof checker establishes the generator and Poisson identities symbolically on all 16 states and independently reproduces both cumulants from full rational Markov matrices at eight parameter pairs; the analytic proof, not finite sampling, establishes the all-parameter claim.

value.rationale: The noise of signed heat transfer is a physically natural and mathematically informative trajectory observable that the static Ising solution and mean entropy production do not determine. The smallest nondegenerate alternating-temperature simple ring admits a closed Poisson corrector yielding an exact nonlinear current/variance identity for all permitted bath contrasts, and the infinite-hot-bath case has a sharp, unique unit-dispersion threshold. These are exact nonperturbative finite-size kinetic benchmarks, not an arbitrary single parameter substitution; no thermodynamic extension is asserted.
